faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What is the difference between a certified and a sworn translation?
faq.a1: In many contexts, these terms are used interchangeably. It refers to a translation confirmed by a court-authorized translator, which is legally recognized by authorities.
faq.q2: How fast will I receive the translation?
faq.a2: Standard documents (e.g., birth certificates) are often processed within 24-48 hours. Postal delivery from Spain to Germany takes approx. 3-5 business days.
faq.q3: Do you need the original document?
faq.a3: A legible scan or photo of every page is sufficient for a quote. Before translation, check whether the receiving organisation requires an original, a certified copy or a particular delivery format.
faq.q4: Is the translation valid in Germany?
faq.a4: Authorized by OLG Cologne for Spanish and French. Please check the requirements of the receiving authority.
faq.a5: You will receive an invoice including VAT. Payment is made conveniently via bank transfer.

aboutPage.title: Your certified translator

aboutPage.paragraph1: For over three decades I have helped individuals, law firms, notaries and businesses translate documents for international procedures.
aboutPage.paragraph2: My specialization in law, economics, and official documentation allows me to translate with the terminological precision that official bodies require. Every comma, every legal term, every formality counts.
aboutPage.paragraph3: I work from Ourense, Spain, serving clients online in Spain, Germany and other countries. We confirm the destination and requirements before starting the translation.
aboutPage.conclusion: Direct contact, no intermediaries. You talk to me, I translate your document, and I deliver it personally. It's that simple.

example.title: Example: a German birth certificate
example.intro: For a translation into Spanish, send a legible image of every page, including stamps and attachments. Specify the receiving authority and your deadline.
steps: We review the length, languages and any attachments that need translating.
You receive a quote specifying the total amount, applicable taxes, deadline, delivery format and included copies.
Requested postage and any rush surcharge are itemized separately. Translation starts once you accept the quote.

serviceBrief.title: Before sending your document
serviceBrief.description: Specify the source and target languages, receiving authority and deadline. Send legible copies of all pages and attachments to be translated. We will confirm the delivery format and requirements before starting.

birth-certificate: Send every page of the certificate, including the reverse, stamps and any marginal notes.
Specify the destination country and receiving organisation, and whether any accompanying attachments or apostille should also be translated.
marriage-certificate: Send the complete certificate with all annotations and additional pages.
Let us know if related documents, such as a family record book or divorce judgment, are part of the request so they can be included in the quote.
university-degree: Send both sides of the degree certificate, along with transcripts and diploma supplements if they form part of your application.
Specify the receiving institution and the documents it has asked you to translate. Each document and its attachments are considered in the quote.
contracts: Send the complete contract, including any tables, signatures and attachments that need translating.
Specify the target language, intended use and whether you need a certified translation or a specialist translation without certification.
court-documents: Send the complete decision, with every page and any attachments you want included in the translation.
Specify the receiving organisation and your deadline. If there are several case documents, identify which ones need translating.
retirement-pension: Send the complete letters or decisions, including the periods, amounts and attachments shown in them.
Specify the documents to translate and the receiving organisation. Several letters or certificates can be grouped into a single quote.
notarial-documents: Send the complete deed, power of attorney or notarial document, with legible stamps and attachments.
Specify the destination country, recipient and number of copies needed. Include any accompanying apostille so it can be considered in the quote.
